_about: A18 line clauses. Each entry names what one lesson must say on screen about what its engine leaves out. Source: docs/conformance-matrix.md (PR #148). 'require' patterns must all match the text of ONE tour step, and that step must carry a claim whose source matches 'source'. 'banInLine' applies to that step. 'banAnywhere' applies to the whole tour, claims included. 'example' is a line that passes, for the self-check. The words of the real line belong to the tour author. 'readClaims' adds the text of the step's own claims to the line, for a line that lives in a claim.

lines.example: This engine leaves out HelloRetryRequest, P-256, RSA and ECDSA signatures, and ChaCha20.
This engine leaves out the 3DES suite, session resumption, and the client certificate.
The RSA class says false on bad padding. It does not stay quiet, so the TLS 1.1 server hides the answer. Do not copy this class.
This engine leaves out rekey, password login, 3des-cbc, diffie-hellman-group1-sha1 and ssh-dss.
This check leaves out revocation, policy processing, and name constraints.
This lab does not run every DPoP step. It runs only some of them, with EdDSA only, and the caller stops a replay.
This lesson runs AES DUKPT, from ANSI X9.24-3.
If a reader's registers leak, past keys stay safe and later keys do not. A single leaked PIN key exposes only that sale.
